From: Jake Reynolds <jake@vendr.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr security onboarding — prerequisites and SSO

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the heads-up — welcome aboard. I put together the basic onboarding checklist and a short SIG/SOC2 intake we typically need to create a profile in Vendr. Attached: vendr_onboarding_prereqs.pdf (checklist), and a small SIG mapping template.

High-level asks:
- SOC 2 report (latest snapshot) or SOC2 letter + date range
- Export of controls referenced in CAIQ/SIG where possible (we accept the SIG spreadsheet)
- A service account or SSO contact to provision API access for uploads

If you can share the SOC2 snapshot and either upload it to the Drive link below or reply with a signed copy, we’ll start the profile creation and route you a support ticket to set up SSO (SAML).

Attachments: vendr_onboarding_prereqs.pdf (pdf), sig_mapping_template.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Jake Reynolds
Head of Security Integrations | Vendr
jake@vendr.io | +1 415-555-0123

- Mina: can you validate the attached SOC2 snapshot is the latest (Q4 2026) and drop any missing control artifacts into the Drive folder Jake shared? Vendr specifically asked for control references they can map to the SIG spreadsheet.

Jake — we uploaded the SOC2 snapshot to the Drive link and also attached a copy here. Let me know if you need a signed assertion or a bridge letter.

Hi all — quick inventory from my side after skimming the SOC2 snapshot we uploaded.

Notes: 
- SOC2 report: Q4 2026 (Type II) — good to upload to vendor portal. I recommend we redact internal IP addresses in the attachments before upload and include a signed cover letter.
- SIG mapping: I populated the spreadsheet with control IDs we commonly share (column: "Redwood control ref"). Please review the new tab I added in the Drive file.
- Missing artifacts: evidence for control CC6.1 (third-party encryption key rotation) and A.7.2 (onboarding background checks). I have short PDFs that summarize rotation policy + proof-of-rotation logs; attaching filenames below and uploading to the Drive folder.

Attachments uploaded to Drive:
- rotation_policy_summary.pdf
- key_rotation_audit_excerpt.csv
- background_check_summary.pdf

Jake — once Karthik creates the SSO ticket let us know the test window and any metadata you need from our IdP team (we use Okta). If Vendr needs a transient service account for API uploads, we prefer a scoped service account rather than long-lived keys.

Mina Haddad
Sr. Security Analyst | Redwood Inference
